mentions.name: Camera module with built-in SLAM
mentions.description: A camera module with SLAM built in, running on a single-core ARMv7 processor. It includes visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and loop closure, and is being optimized further to see if basic mapping can also fit on the hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a camera module that has SLAM built-in:
https://x.com/_asadmemon/status/1989417143398797424

Running on a single-core armv7. It includes a VIO and a nice loop closure. I am now optimizing it further to see if I can fit some basic mapping too.
